services.name: Wood window restoration
services.blurb: Old sashes taken out, repaired, reglazed and rehung with new cords, keeping the original glass.

services.name: Window replacement
services.blurb: Vinyl, fiberglass or wood windows in styles that match the age of your house.

services.name: Impact windows near the beach
services.blurb: Impact glass for beach and river homes where salt air and storms are part of the year.

services.name: Patio and sliding doors
services.blurb: Sliders and swinging patio doors fitted to old and new openings, sealed against sideways rain.

services.name: Entry doors
services.blurb: Front doors in wood or fiberglass, with transoms and sidelights matched to the porch.

services.name: Sash cord and balance repair
services.blurb: Broken ropes and balances replaced so double-hung windows open and stay where you leave them.

services.name: Rot and sill repair
services.blurb: Soft sills and frames cut out and rebuilt with wood epoxy or new stock, then painted.

services.name: Historic district help

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Two companies wanted to replace all eighteen windows in our 1922 Riverside house. Grant restored the sashes, kept the wavy glass and rebuilt two sills. They open with one hand now.
reviews.name: Hannah W.

reviews.text: Every window in our Avondale bungalow had broken cords and was propped open with sticks. They replaced the cords and weights in two days. Small thing, but it changed the house.
reviews.name: Mark S.

reviews.text: Our house in Springfield is in a historic district. They told us what needed approval, drew up the window details and waited for the go-ahead before ordering anything.
reviews.name: Denise O.

reviews.text: Salt air had eaten the old aluminum windows at our beach cottage. They installed impact windows that still look like a cottage, and the permit passed on the first visit.
reviews.name: Brian T.

reviews.text: The patio slider in our Mandarin ranch leaked in every afternoon storm. New door, new sill pan, and the floor has been dry since July.
reviews.name: Angela R.

reviews.text: We needed twelve windows replaced in a 1990s house. They suggested simple grids that fit the house instead of the fancy ones in the brochure. Clean install, tidy crew.
reviews.name: Craig D.

proof.guarantee: If a window can be restored for less than replacing it, we tell you and price both.
